concern_summary: A cohesive set of functionalities dedicated to displaying user-specific information through tooltips, providing context about users, enhancing the user experience while interacting with avatars and user elements.
This concern encompasses functionalities related to managing and displaying a user's profile, including personal details, avatar settings, public profile access, and profile management features.
A collection of functionalities that manage the rendering, positioning, and visibility of tooltip components based on user interactions and content changes.
Functionalities that retrieve and display user names with tooltips, providing additional context about participants, particularly within chat interfaces.
Functionalities that generate tooltip text and associated information to provide contextual insights related to participants and their details, enhancing user interaction through clarity.
Functionalities focused on assignee tooltip details, responsible for retrieving and displaying information about task assignees, enhancing user understanding of responsibilities.
Educational tooltips that manage the display of additional informative content, influenced by user interactions and configurable conditions, to enhance understanding of features.

This concern encompasses functionalities related to the operation and user notification of the application during offline mode, including managing user interactions and indicating the application's offline status.
This concern includes functionalities for managing and displaying profile data and policies, with an emphasis on generating and viewing detailed views of profiles based on specific identifiers.
Functionalities responsible for displaying contextual information about report actions or navigation buttons to enhance user understanding and interaction.
